reviews.title: Very generous content, can be convoluted.
reviews.text:
Firstly, I feel like quitting the game because the game crashes whenever I load my first character. There’s so much going on I can’t imagine what’s causing it. Perhaps an option on the character select screen to wipe whatever the characters are currently doing to spawn them back at the beginning as something of a failsafe might be an idea, idk.

The abundance of systems that all feed into each other is good fun, but also gets overwhelming. It’s very easy to get lost in it all and miss vital details. The quests are actually kind of annoying as you have to go back to the quest giver to finish them. It’s wasted time and remembering where everything is is a mental load that’s already borderline too much.

It was still one of the best games on the App Store since there’s no ads and you could play and play. But the game crashing one of my characters really ruins it.

reviews.title: GREATEST RPG GAME EVER MADE
reviews.text:
First of all the gameplay is hilarious and one of a kind. The game makes fun of you for screwing up or doing something stupid, i mean how creative do you have to be in order to come up with a pun/insult for every single scenario. Second of all it’s balanced, I mean yeah it’s grindy but that the point you have to spend your time wisely in order to progress faster and more enjoyably. Sure you can complain that “ohhh it’s too hard to understand what to do next” like come on it’s called “quests” and the vault also helps by giving you upgrades based on how much you upgrade. So it basically holds your hand in progression. Third, the buyable packs are well worth it because of the fact that what you are paying is like 1/2 of what it could be and still be somewhat reasonable. Finally is the ONLY thing I would recommend as a update, is you being able to select what pack you can buy like a store just for packs so you don’t have to wait for the day long rotation. 

PS (LavaFlame2 if you see this you should totally give me “one measly gem” XD love the work you’ve done with this game it has been a big part of my happiness lately and even since release day)


Sincerely 
-SlayerBoi10

reviews.title: Badly broken game, developer is garbage
reviews.text: The thing is that this game is often lots of fun. Unfortunately, it’s riddled with bugs and poor planning. At one point (very recently) he made his own game inaccessible for over a month for people playing on iOS. This he blamed on iOS, but iOS players are regularly locked out of the game due to an unwillingness to clear it with iOS ahead of release. The developer reads his support emails once a week and often replies, but if the issue is complex enough, the issue is never fixed, and he simply stops replying. There are so many confounding bugs in the game right now. A quick perusal of its sub-Reddit tells the story, but the developer also regularly deletes posts pointing out his shortcomings. All this, and the game becomes more and more expensive every day.
